Context: 3. Certain Special Entries.-

- (iii) Technical resignation.Against the entry of a technical resignation, it should be clearly indicated that the benefit(s) under Rule 26 (3) of Pension Rules are admissible. No separate orders are required in this regard. However, reference to the Order will be given together with the entry for relief of the official. - GID (5), Rule 26 (3) of Pension Rules.
